description: This file contains support routines for manipulating loose objects in a version control system, likely Git. It defines a function 'loose_obj' that writes a loose object into the object database, including computing its hash, compressing it, and storing it in the appropriate directory structure.

methods.name: loose_obj
methods.description: Writes a loose object into the repository's object database at a specified path with a given object type, reading contents from stdin, calculates its hash, compresses, and stores it.
